title: Foreplay
director: John G. Avildsen, Bruce Malmuth, Robert McCarty
writer: Dan Greenburg, Jack Richardson, Bruce Jay Friedman
actors: Irwin Corey, Pat Paulsen, Deborah Loomis
plot: Three vignettes about a man who buys a weird doll, a writer who is visited by his muse and a kidnapper with very odd demands who holds a VIP.
